metadata.question: Did Dallasport, Washington reach air temperatures of at least 95 degrees fahrenheit in July 2022?

data.raw_code: The user is asking about air temperatures in Dallasport, Washington in July 2022, specifically if temperatures reached at least 95°F. For temperature data, I should use: - ERA5-Land hourly data (ECMWF/ERA5_LAND/HOURLY) which has temperature_2m band - Convert from Kelvin to Fahrenheit - Look for maximum daily temperature in July 2022 Let me break this down: 1. Location: Dallasport, Washington - I'll use approximate coordinates (46.3, -123.6) 2. Date: July 2022 (2022-07-01 to 2022-07-31) 3. Data: ERA5-Land hourly temperature data 4. Processing: Find maximum temperature in the month, convert to Fahrenheit, check if >= 95°F I need to handle: - Check if collection has data (C1) - Check if we get valid temperature values (C3) - Output appropriate answer based on whether max temp >= 95°F The temperature_2m band in ERA5 is in Kelvin, so conversion is needed: °F = (K - 273.15) × 9/5 + 32 ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const point = ee.Geometry.Point([-123.6, 46.3]); // Dallasport, WA approximate coordinates const startDate = '2022-07-01'; const endDate = '2022-07-31'; // 2. Data Acquisition - ERA5-Land for temperature const tempCollection = ee.ImageCollection('ECMWF/ERA5_LAND/HOURLY') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(point) .select('temperature_2m'); const collectionSize = tempCollection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`July 2022 temperature images: ${collectionSize}`); if (collectionSize === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Processing - Calculate maximum temperature for the month const maxTempImage = tempCollection.max(); // 4. Calculation - Get temperature value and convert from Kelvin to Fahrenheit const tempResult = maxTempImage.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: point, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('temperature_2m'); const tempKelvin = tempResult.getInfo(); // Check for invalid temperature if (tempKelvin === null || tempKelvin === undefined || tempKelvin < 200 || tempKelvin > 350) { console.log(`Invalid temperature value: ${tempKelvin}`); console.log("C3"); return; } // Convert Kelvin to Fahrenheit const tempFahrenheit = (tempKelvin - 273.15) * 9/5 + 32; // 5. Validation & Final Answer console.log(`Max temperature in July 2022: ${tempFahrenheit.toFixed(1)}°F`); if (tempFahrenheit >= 95) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
